name: recast-navigation-js
description: WebAssembly port of Recast/Detour for runtime navmesh construction, pathfinding, spatial queries and crowd simulation in browser/Node game stacks.

licence.notice: Repository and published package metadata identify MIT licensing; preserve required notice.

provenance.notes: Canonical repository for the JS/WASM port, pinned to release 0.43.1.

maintenance.evidence: Repository is active and release commit 0.43.1 includes current TypeScript compatibility fixes; public examples cover Three.js/browser and worker paths.
maintenance.notes: Revalidate WASM/browser bundling behavior and exact package versions at adoption.

compatibility.notes: Designed for Node/browser JS stacks. Mobile web feasibility depends on scene size, WASM memory, generation frequency and crowd budgets.

risk.legalNotes: MIT is commercially compatible; validate any example-level assets independently.
risk.securityNotes: WASM/npm dependency chain and runtime-generated navigation data require ordinary supply-chain and input-boundary review.

assessment.notes: Strong solved-system candidate for browser navmesh/pathfinding before custom A*, navigation mesh generation or crowd code. Benchmark memory/build cost against engine-native navigation where available.

evidence.notes: Pinned v0.43.1 source; repository documents runtime navmesh generation, Detour queries/crowds and browser/Node compatibility.

publication.notes: Publish as a qualified navigation candidate with WebAssembly/dependency/performance caveats and project-specific benchmark requirement.
